note: Definitions are data. 'supported_locally' lists the datasets present on this machine that can supply the outcome with the stated definition; an outcome with an empty list is defined but cannot be trained or evaluated here. Incompatible definitions across cohorts are never pooled: each definition names its own supporting datasets.

outcomes.definition: Death from any cause. Derived as the union of the cause groups death:cvd, death:cancer, death:other (an all-cause curve is the sum of the three cumulative incidences).

source_definitions.nhanes_mortality: MORTSTAT = 1 in the public-use linked mortality file; follow-up months PERMTH_EXM; administrative censoring 2019-12-31

caveats: NCHS perturbs follow-up and cause of death for some public-use records
ELIGSTAT must be 1: ineligible participants are excluded, not censored

outcomes.definition: Death with underlying cause heart disease or cerebrovascular disease.

source_definitions.nhanes_mortality: UCOD_LEADING recode 001 (diseases of heart, I00-I09, I11, I13, I20-I51) or 005 (cerebrovascular diseases, I60-I69)

caveats: a cause of death is not an incident cardiovascular event: it excludes survived MI, stroke and heart failure

outcomes.definition: Death with underlying cause malignant neoplasm.
caveats: cancer INCIDENCE is not defined here: no local source records incident cancer consistently across cohorts

outcomes.definition: First diagnosis of type 2 diabetes after a washout free of diabetes at entry.
outcomes.washout_for_incident: participants with a diabetes diagnosis, antidiabetic medication, HbA1c >= 6.5 percent or fasting glucose >= 126 mg/dL at entry are excluded
caveats: NHANES records prevalent self-reported diabetes only; no incident diagnoses follow the examination
requires a cohort with repeated checkups (CARDIA, Whitehall II, DPP/DPPOS, Look AHEAD): not present locally

outcomes.definition: First non-fatal or fatal myocardial infarction after a washout.
outcomes.first_qualifying_event: first adjudicated or coded MI after entry
first adjudicated or coded stroke after entry

outcomes.definition: First heart failure diagnosis after a washout.
outcomes.first_qualifying_event: first adjudicated or coded heart failure after entry
outcomes.washout_for_incident: no prior heart failure at entry

outcomes.definition: First eGFR below 60 mL/min/1.73 m2 confirmed on a later measurement, or a coded CKD diagnosis, after a washout.
outcomes.first_qualifying_event: first confirmed qualifying record after entry
outcomes.washout_for_incident: eGFR >= 60 and no CKD diagnosis at entry
caveats: NHANES has one creatinine per participant: a confirmation visit cannot exist

outcomes.definition: First of MI, stroke or cardiovascular death.
outcomes.washout_for_incident: no prior MI or stroke at entry
caveats: composite: requires its components from one cohort with a common adjudication

outcomes.first_qualifying_event: first admission (recurrent admissions need their own at-risk windows)
